items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: "And Molly, bar the door, that was it."

ctx.x: We laid that on them to stir them up, you know. And Molly, bar the door, that was it. Yeah. But all our theater programs, we always closed it with "Mood Indigo." Stage blacked out, just big, pinpoint lights on trombones, clarinets, and Carnev, baritone. And I was singing way in the distance, high falsetto, obbligato.
Oh, right, you mentioned that. You mentioned that you also put that on them when you were in Europe in that white --
